subject: Английский язык
authors: Ваулина Ю. Е., Дули Д., Эванс В.

problems.condition: Ex. 1. Match the words with the pictures: bus, train, plane, bike.
steps: train — поезд, plane — самолёт, bike — велосипед.
Соответствие определяется по контексту рисунка в учебнике.
problems.answer: bus — автобус, train — поезд, plane — самолёт, bike — велосипед.

problems.condition: Ex. 2. Fill in: by, on, in. "I go to school ___ foot."
steps: Предлог движения пешком — on foot (устойчивое выражение).

problems.condition: Ex. 5. Complete with the correct form of "be": He ___ a student.
steps: Форма глагола be в Present Simple для he/she/it — is.

problems.condition: Ex. 8. Translate into English: «Я люблю читать книги».
steps: Я — I, люблю — like/love, читать — to read, книги — books.
I like to read books. / I love reading books.

problems.condition: Ex. 3. Write questions. "He can swim." → Can he swim?
steps: Вопросительная форма с модальным глаголом can: can + подлежащее + инфинитив.

problems.condition: Ex. 2. Present Continuous. "She ___ (read) now." Fill in.
Ex. 4. Translate: «Я умею играть на гитаре».
steps: Умею = can. Играть на гитаре = play the guitar.

problems.condition: Ex. 1. Write the plural of the nouns: class, teacher, subject.
steps: class → classes (после ch, sh, s, x, z добавляем -es).

problems.condition: Ex. 5. Use Present Simple. "She (study) English every day."
steps: She — 3-е лицо ед.ч. В Present Simple добавляем -es/-s к глаголу.
study → studies (после согласной + y меняем y → i + es).

problems.condition: Ex. 3. Write: "What subjects do you study?"
steps: do you study — общий вопрос с do для 2-го лица.
Ответ: I study Maths, Russian, English, History, etc.
problems.answer: I study Maths, Russian, English and other subjects.

problems.condition: Ex. 2. Use Past Simple. "We ___ (visit) the museum last week."
Ex. 1. Describe your house. Write 3 sentences using "there is / there are".
steps: There is a living room in my house.
There is a small garden near the house.
problems.answer: Пример: There is a living room. There are two bedrooms. There is a kitchen.

problems.condition: Ex. 1. Fill in: near, next to, opposite, between. "The bank is ___ the park."
steps: Near — рядом, next to — рядом с, opposite — напротив, between — между.
По контексту предложения и рисунка выбирается подходящий предлог.
problems.answer: Зависит от карты: например, "The bank is opposite the park."

problems.condition: Ex. 4. Describe your room. Use "there is" / "there are".
steps: Единственное число: There is a bed.
problems.answer: There is a desk in my room. There are bookshelves on the wall.

problems.condition: Ex. 3. Compare using "bigger than / smaller than": elephant, cat, mouse.
steps: An elephant is bigger than a cat.
A cat is bigger than a mouse.
problems.answer: An elephant is bigger than a cat. A cat is bigger than a mouse.

problems.condition: Ex. 2. Write: "Where is the cinema?" Use a map.
steps: The cinema is next to / opposite / between...
Example: The cinema is next to the park.
problems.answer: The cinema is next to the park.

problems.condition: Ex. 1. Write comparative forms: big, expensive, good.
Ex. 3. Use "would like to". "What ___ you ___ to do?"
steps: What would you like to do?

problems.condition: Ex. 1. Match jobs with descriptions: teacher, doctor, chef.
problems.answer: teacher — teaches children, doctor — treats patients, chef — cooks food.

problems.condition: Ex. 2. Translate: «Он работает врачом».

chapters.title: Module 6. All in a Day's Work

problems.condition: Ex. 1. Put the verbs in Past Simple: "I (watch) a film yesterday."
steps: Past Simple правильных глаголов образуется добавлением -ed.

problems.condition: Ex. 3. Write about yesterday. "Yesterday I ___ (go) to school."
Ex. 5. Use "will". "In 10 years robots ___ (do) all the work."
steps: Robots will do all the work.

problems.condition: Ex. 5. Write Past Simple of irregular verbs: go, see, have.
Ex. 1. Fill in: should/shouldn't. "You ___ eat too much sugar."
steps: should — совет делать что-то, shouldn't — совет не делать.
Не есть много сахара — это рекомендация избегать, значит shouldn't.

problems.condition: Ex. 3. Modal verbs. "You ___ eat more vegetables." (advice)
Ex. 1. Write sentences about a hero using: brave, strong, kind.
steps: A hero is brave — герой храбрый.
A hero is strong — герой сильный.
A hero is kind — герой добрый.
problems.answer: A hero is brave, strong and kind.

problems.condition: Ex. 2. Passive voice. "The book ___ (write) by Pushkin."
steps: The book was written by Pushkin.

problems.condition: Ex. 1. Fill in the missing words: recycle, reuse, reduce.
problems.answer: recycle — recycling materials; reuse — using again; reduce — using less.
